title: Uruguayan-Style Asado
description: A traditional Uruguayan asado recipe featuring grilled meats and a tangy sauce.

ingredients.name: Flank Steak
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality cut for optimal flavor.

ingredients.name: Morcilla (Uruguayan Blood Sausage)
ingredients.notes: You can substitute with other blood sausage if needed.

ingredients.name: Chimichurri Sauce
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, whichever suits your taste.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher or sea salt for best results.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground pepper enhances the flavor.

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: Add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice for brightness.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince for added depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.notes: Chopped for garnish and added freshness.

instructions: Preheat your grill to medium-high heat (around 400°F/200°C).
Season the flank steak with salt, black pepper, and a sprinkle of parsley.
Grill the flank steak for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or until your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, grill the morcilla links until nicely charred and cooked through.
Once the steak is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes.
Slice the steak against the grain and serve with grilled morcilla, chimichurri sauce, and a side of your favorite Uruguayan-inspired sides.
For the chimichurri sauce, combine parsley, garlic, lemon juice, and olive oil in a bowl. Mix well and adjust seasoning as needed.
To serve, place the sliced steak on a platter or individual plates, and top with a spoonful of chimichurri sauce.
Garnish with additional parsley and serve immediately.
For a rest, let the steak sit for a few minutes before slicing to allow the juices to redistribute.
